title: Peruvian Avocado Ceviche Rolls
description: A unique fusion of Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sushi, featuring fresh avocado and zesty Peruvian flavors.
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to package directions.
Cut the yellowfin tuna into thin slices.
Mix the diced avocado with Zesty Peruvian Sauce.
Lay a sheet of nori seaweed flat on a sushi mat.
Spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the seaweed.
Place a few slices of tuna in the middle of the rice.
Add a spoonful of the avocado mixture on top of the tuna.
Roll the sushi using the mat, applying gentle pressure.
Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces.
Garnish with a thin slice of cucumber and serve with a lime wedge.
